FAQ
How do we get started working together?
A:

Fill out our form so we can learn how we can best help you and your business! From there, we will reach out for next steps!

What's your typical turnaround time for projects?
A:

This depends on the complexity. For social media content, we like to be at the least, one month in advance with our content, but we typically turn it around within the week for first review. For more of our custom work, we need however much time the project calls for. However, we also need to factor in however much time you need to review our content!

Do you work with clients outside your local area?
A:

Absolutely! We actually have completed over 500 productions outside of our local area, so we have the remote production thing worked out! We work with clients nationwide and have successfully managed remote productions. For distant locations, we coordinate local crews or factor travel costs into the project budget, when needed.

What's included in your video production services?
A:

We stretch or shrink to your needs, however, we most commonly are assigned with strategy consultation, copywriting, producing, production, and post production needs.

How do you handle revisions and feedback?
A:

We want to give our clients exactly what they want, but we also know that we are the professionals and you are looking for our guidance. With that balance in mind, we will always make our voices heard with revisions and feedback that we don't necessarily agree with, but are more than accommodatingif one feels strongly!

What information do you need from us before we begin?
A:

We'll need everything you got! Brand guidelines, logos, data, audience demographic, and one person in your company that can be our main point of contact.

Can you work within our existing brand guidelines?
A:

Yes, we excel at working within established brand guidelines. We'll review your brand standards during our discovery phase and ensure all creative elements align with your visual identity, tone, and messaging requirements.

What formats will we receive our final videos in?
A:

This will be handled on a case-by-case basis, but we typically provide a compressed version for use on your digital platforms, as well as a decompressed, higher quality video that you can repurpose on your own.

Do you provide ongoing video marketing strategy support?
A:

Our team is available throughout our entire engagement to make sure you feel the most supported in every stage of the process.

How do we schedule a consultation to discuss our project?
A:

Click on one of the buttons to be redirected to our form, where we will get to learn a little more about you and see how we could potentially partner. From there, if the project seems like it would be a great fit for us, we will get you on the calendar!

OUR STORY
CHANGED COMPANIES CHANGE CULTURE

The story of our growth into a commitment to branding with virtue

MEET CAMERON

It all started with him.

Founder & Head of Creative
Cameron aka @bsblbro

After leaving college with a Cinematic Arts Degree and retiring his Major League Baseball dreams, Cameron decided to mix his two passions and started a niche baseball account on Instagram, TikTok, and Youtube.

Over the next two years, Cameron discovered he had a skill...

A skill that most businesses started to really need in 2020.
‍
Like a true entrepreneur, Cameron started
clear sky
‍The mission was simple:
Help businesses grow their visibility on social media through quality content.

Over time, each new project was better than the previous. The Clear Sky team expanded and the services widened.
‍
Clear Sky grew from a single-person social content company to a full-service creative agency over the span of five years.
‍
But then, we noticed a trend (and not a great one)...

The social landscape today is polluted with misleading ads, fake news, and the sales-at-all-cost mentality. Consumer trust in brands is at an all-time low. Companies caught up in this get exposed and decimated. People get exhausted from the platforms.

In other words:
Social Media needs a Renaissance!

OUR MISSION
To build good brands with honest content.

Helping CEO's, creators, marketing heads, and other creatives in companies make a difference in how we create and consume content online.

Our vision is to trail blaze the path back to trust-filled marketing. This vision is reinforced by our commitment to using ethically-sound methods of promoting your business online.

We are rooted in values of transparency, integrity, love and selflessness.

If we are successful in our path, we can only hope to help correct the course of how we interact with one another.

Because at the end of the day...

CHANGED COMPANIES CHANGE CULTURE

Let's Grow!

PRIVACY POLICY

Effective Date: 9/16/25

Last Updated: 9/16/25




Clear Sky Creations, LLC (“we,” “our,” or “us”) values your privacy. This Privacy Policy explains how we collect, use, and protect your personal information when you interact with our website, services, and marketing campaigns.




INFORMATION WE COLLECT

We may collect the following types of information:

Personal Information: Name, email address, and other contact details you voluntarily provide when signing up for our newsletters, requesting information, or engaging with our services.
Automatically Collected Information: When you visit our website, we may collect non-personal data such as your IP address, browser type, and usage information through cookies or similar technologies (see Section 6).
‍

HOW WE USE YOUR INFORMATION

We use the information we collect to:

Send marketing emails, newsletters, and drip campaign communications.
Respond to inquiries and provide customer support.
Improve our services, website, and communication with you.


NO SELLING OR SHARING OF PERSONAL DATA

Clear Sky Creations, LLC does not sell, rent, or share your personal information with third parties. All information collected is used exclusively by us to serve and communicate with you.
‍

YOUR CALIFORNIA PRIVACY RIGHTS (CCPA)

If you are a California resident, you have the right to:

Know: Request disclosure of the categories and specific pieces of personal information we have collected about you.
Delete: Request that we delete your personal information, subject to certain exceptions.
Opt-Out: Request to opt out of the sale of your personal information (though we do not sell personal data, this right is still provided under CCPA).
Non-Discrimination: We will not discriminate against you for exercising your privacy rights.


To exercise these rights, contact us using the information in the Section titled “Contact Us”.
‍

DATA SECURITY

We implement reasonable security measures to protect your personal information from unauthorized access, use, or disclosure. However, no method of transmission or storage is 100% secure, and we cannot guarantee absolute security.
‍

COOKIES AND TRACKING TECHNOLOGIES

Our website may use cookies or similar tracking technologies (such as Google Analytics) to collect information about how you use our site. This helps us analyze trends and improve the user experience. You can disable cookies through your browser settings, though some features of our site may not function properly without them.
‍

DATA RETENTION

We retain personal information only as long as necessary to fulfill the purposes outlined in this Privacy Policy, comply with legal obligations, and resolve disputes.
‍

CONTACT US

If you have any questions about this Privacy Policy, or if you wish to exercise your privacy rights, please contact us at:

Clear Sky Creations, LLC
Email: privacy@clearskycreations.com
